{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check which rows have missing values in either variable
missing_flipper = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()
missing_mass = df['body_mass_g'].isnull()

# Count overlapping missingness
overlap_missing = (missing_flipper & missing_mass).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with missing values in both variables: {overlap_missing}')

# Drop rows with any missing value in either variable
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
print(f'Number of rows after dropping missing values: {len(df_clean)}')"}
